description: The woman wears a fully opaque burgundy-red long gown with a closed upright collar just below the chin and full sleeves reaching the wrists. Gold-brown floral woven borders run down the front, around the collar, cuffs and floor-length closed hem. A heavy brown patterned cloak covers the shoulders and hangs down both sides, joined across the upper chest by two round brooches and a short gold chain. A decorated leather belt has small gold round fittings and a long patterned strap. Only her face and hands show above the clothing, with dark leather boots beneath the closed skirt.
